flowElements.questionText: Did you pay any estimated federal taxes to the IRS?
flowElements.rawXml:
<fg-set path="/paidEstimatedTaxesOrFromLastYear">
  <question>
    Did you pay any
    <fg-show path="/taxYear"/>
    estimated federal taxes to the IRS?
  </question>
  <input type="boolean"/>
</fg-set>

flowElements.questionText: Did you make any of these estimated federal tax payments under a legal name that changed in ?
flowElements.rawXml:
<fg-set path="/paidEstimatedTaxesOrFromLastYearUnderDifferentName">
  <question>
    Did you make any of these estimated federal tax payments under a legal name that changed in
    <fg-show path="/taxYear"/>
    ?
  </question>
  <input type="boolean"/>
</fg-set>

flowElements.questionText: Were any of these estimated federal tax payments made with a former spouse?
flowElements.rawXml:
<fg-set path="/paidEstimatedTaxesWithFormerSpouse">
  <question>
    Were any of these estimated
    <fg-show path="/taxYear"/>
    federal tax payments made with a former spouse?
  </question>
  <input type="enum" options-path="/paidEstimatedTaxesWithFormerSpouseOptions">
    <option value="spouseDid">
      Yes,
      <fg-show path="/secondaryFiler/firstName"/>
      made estimated
      <fg-show path="/taxYear"/>
      federal tax payments with their former spouse
    </option>
    <option value="bothDid">
      Yes,
      <fg-show path="/secondaryFiler/firstName"/>
      and I both made estimated
      <fg-show path="/taxYear"/>
      federal tax payments with our former spouses
    </option>
    <option value="tpDid">
      Yes, I made estimated
      <fg-show path="/taxYear"/>
      federal tax payments with my former spouse
    </option>
    <option value="neither">No, or doesn’t apply</option>
  </input>
</fg-set>

<fg-set path="/primaryFilerDivorcedSpouseTaxID">
  <question>Enter their 9-digit SSN or ITIN</question>
  <input type="tin"/>
</fg-set>

flowElements.questionText: Total estimated federal taxes paid for
flowElements.rawXml:
<fg-set path="/estimatedTaxPaymentWritable">
  <question>Total estimated federal taxes paid for
    <fg-show path="/taxYear"/>
  </question>
  <input type="dollar"/>
</fg-set>

facts.name: Paid estimated taxes with former spouse options
facts.description: Options for which TP paid estimated taxes with a former spouse
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/paidEstimatedTaxesWithFormerSpouseOptions">
  <Name>Paid estimated taxes with former spouse options</Name>
  <Description>Options for which TP paid estimated taxes with a former spouse</Description>
  <Derived>
    <EnumOptions>
      <EnumOption>
        <Condition>
          <Dependency module="filingStatus" path="/isFilingStatusMFJ"/>
        </Condition>
        <Value>
          <String>spouseDid</String>
        </Value>
      </EnumOption>
      <EnumOption>
        <Condition>
          <Dependency module="filingStatus" path="/isFilingStatusMFJ"/>
        </Condition>
        <Value>
          <String>bothDid</String>
        </Value>
      </EnumOption>
      <String>tpDid</String>
      <String>neither</String>
    </EnumOptions>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.description: Has the Filer answered all the necessary questions in estimated taxes?
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/estimatedTaxesIsComplete">
  <Description>Has the Filer answered all the necessary questions in estimated taxes?</Description>
  <Export downstreamFacts="true"/>
  <Derived>
    <Any>
      <All>
        <IsComplete>
          <Dependency path="/paidEstimatedTaxesOrFromLastYear"/>
        </IsComplete>
        <Not>
          <Dependency path="/paidEstimatedTaxesOrFromLastYear"/>
        </Not>
      </All>
      <All>
        <IsComplete>
          <Dependency path="/paidEstimatedTaxesOrFromLastYear"/>
        </IsComplete>
        <Dependency path="/paidEstimatedTaxesOrFromLastYear"/>
        <IsComplete>
          <Dependency path="/paidEstimatedTaxesOrFromLastYearUnderDifferentName"/>
        </IsComplete>
        <IsComplete>
          <Dependency path="/paidEstimatedTaxesWithFormerSpouse"/>
        </IsComplete>
        <Any>
          <Not>
            <Dependency path="/tpPaidEstimatedTaxesWithFormerSpouse"/>
          </Not>
          <All>
            <Dependency path="/tpPaidEstimatedTaxesWithFormerSpouse"/>
            <IsComplete>
              <Dependency path="/primaryFilerDivorcedSpouseTaxID"/>
            </IsComplete>
          </All>
        </Any>
        <Any>
          <Not>
            <Dependency path="/spousePaidEstimatedTaxesWithFormerSpouse"/>
          </Not>
          <All>
            <Dependency path="/spousePaidEstimatedTaxesWithFormerSpouse"/>
            <IsComplete>
              <Dependency path="/secondaryFilerDivorcedSpouseTaxID"/>
            </IsComplete>
          </All>
        </Any>
        <IsComplete>
          <Dependency path="/estimatedTaxPaymentWritable"/>
        </IsComplete>
      </All>
    </Any>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Estimated And From Last Year
facts.description: 2023 estimated tax payments and amount applied from 2022 return (line 26 1040)
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/estimatedAndFromLastYear">
  <Name>Estimated And From Last Year</Name>
  <Description>2023 estimated tax payments and amount applied from 2022 return (line 26 1040)</Description>
  <Export downstreamFacts="true" mef="true"/>
  <Derived>
    <Round>
      <Switch>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <All>
              <IsComplete>
                <Dependency path="/paidEstimatedTaxesOrFromLastYear"/>
              </IsComplete>
              <Dependency path="/paidEstimatedTaxesOrFromLastYear"/>
            </All>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Dependency path="/estimatedTaxPaymentWritable"/>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <True/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Dollar>0</Dollar>
          </Then>
        </Case>
      </Switch>
    </Round>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/isFilingStatusMFJ">
  <Export downstreamFacts="true" mef="true"/>
  <Derived>
    <Equal>
      <Left>
        <Dependency path="/filingStatus"/>
      </Left>
      <Right>
        <Enum optionsPath="/filingStatusOptions">marriedFilingJointly</Enum>
      </Right>
    </Equal>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/flowIncomplete">
  <Name>Flow is Incomplete</Name>
  <Description>Whether any required sections are incomplete.

        This should be updated whenever a `completeIf` is
        updated
        in the flow</Description>
  <BlockSubmissionOnTrue/>
  <Derived>
    <Not>
      <All>
        <Dependency module="refundPrefs" path="/completedOtherPrefsSection"/>
        <Dependency path="/creditsSectionComplete"/>

        <Dependency module="spouseSection" path="/spouseSectionCompleted"/>
        <Dependency module="estimatedPayments" path="/estimatedTaxesIsComplete"/>
        <Dependency module="cdcc" path="/cdccSectionIsComplete"/>
        <IsComplete>
          <Dependency module="filingStatus" path="/isFilingStatusComplete"/>

        <Dependency module="income" path="/incomeSourcesIsComplete"/>

facts.description: Filer is knocked out if they have no taxable income and no credits, but have HSA distributions.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/knockoutNoPaymentsHsaDistribution">
  <Description>Filer is knocked out if they have no taxable income and no credits, but have HSA distributions.</Description>
  <Export downstreamFacts="true"/>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Not>
        <Dependency module="estimatedPayments" path="/paidEstimatedTaxesOrFromLastYear"/>
      </Not>
      <Dependency module="taxCalculations" path="/knockoutHasNoPaymentsOrCredits"/>
      <Equal>
        <Left>
          <Dependency module="interest" path="/taxExemptInterest"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </Equal>
      <Equal>
        <Left>
          <Dependency module="income" path="/pensionsAndAnnuities"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </Equal>
      <Equal>
        <Left>
          <Dependency module="socialSecurity" path="/socialSecurityBenefits"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </Equal>
      <Any>
        <Dependency path="/primaryFiler/hasHsaDistributions"/>
        <Dependency path="/secondaryFiler/hasHsaDistributions"/>
      </Any>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Total payments
facts.description: Total payments as reported on line 33 of Form 1040.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/totalPayments">
  <Name>Total payments</Name>
  <Description>Total payments as reported on line 33 of Form 1040.</Description>
  <Export mef="true"/>
  <Derived>
    <Round>
      <Add>
        <Dependency path="/totalWithholding"/>
        <Dependency module="estimatedPayments" path="/estimatedAndFromLastYear"/>
        <Dependency path="/totalOtherPaymentsRefundableCredits"/>
      </Add>
    </Round>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Knockout no payments or credits
facts.description: TP is knocked out because they have no payments or credits
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/knockoutHasNoPaymentsOrCredits">
  <Name>Knockout no payments or credits</Name>
  <Description>TP is knocked out because they have no payments or credits</Description>
  <Export downstreamFacts="true"/>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Not>
        <Dependency module="estimatedPayments" path="/paidEstimatedTaxesOrFromLastYear"/>
      </Not>
      <Equal>
        <Left>
          <Dependency module="income" path="/totalIncome"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </Equal>
      <Equal>
        <Left>
          <Dependency path="/agi"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </Equal>
      <Equal>
        <Left>
          <Dependency path="/totalTentativeTax"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </Equal>
      <Equal>
        <Left>
          <Dependency path="/nonRefundableCredits"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </Equal>
      <Equal>
        <Left>
          <Dependency path="/totalTax"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </Equal>
      <Equal>
        <Left>
          <Dependency path="/totalPayments"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </Equal>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>
